original_text: Today we're building a Chrome extension from scratch using Manifest V3.

original_text: We'll use content scripts to interact directly with web page DOM elements.

original_text: Watch how our content script intercepts text nodes and replaces them seamlessly.

original_text: We're using Shadow DOM to isolate our extension UI styles from the page.

original_text: Now our extension tooltip looks pixel-perfect on any website!

original_text: Let's persist user settings using the chrome.storage.local API.

original_text: Testing our extension live in Chrome developer mode works like a charm!
